purpose: Independently reduce the core polynomial obligations and explicit event counterexamples from the immutable prompt in a disposable directory.

scope_limits: The remap certificates are conditional algebra plus finite exact witnesses, not existence or positivity for an approved 26-node remap.
The adjacent deposition identities are conditional on a proposed adjacent-support axiom and do not approve it.
The event witnesses separate R_H zero, red-face zero, and blue-face zero but do not implement event localization, saltation, or restart.
Delta_f versus total f and packet versus occupation rates remain typed authority obligations outside polynomial algebra.

allowed_mutations: raw stdout, tool versions, exact results, semantic projection, and hashes under caller-selected receipt directory
mutation_policy.precondition: Hash the prompt and record git status before execution.
mutation_policy.postcondition: Prompt hash and git status are unchanged.

execution.mode: Run the checked-in exact-arithmetic script read-only and invoke Singular directly only for version capture.

semantic_projection_fields: checks sorted by id with id, holds, and detail

fail_closed: Do not turn the adjacent two-node proposal into an approved locality axiom.
Do not infer positivity inequalities from polynomial ideal membership alone.
Do not infer remap existence, source bytes, implementation parity, or physical admission.
Keep R_H zero, red-face zero, and blue-face zero as distinct typed events.
